title: AI Thumbnail Creator with Generation, Enhancement, and Video Link Features

requirements.text: Create a text input interface where users can enter a text prompt to generate a thumbnail image using AI

quotes: ai se thumbnail create kar sake prompt deke

acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a text prompt in a text input field
A 'Generate' button triggers thumbnail creation
Loading state is shown while generation is in progress
Generated thumbnail is displayed once ready

requirements.text: Implement backend functionality to generate thumbnail images from text prompts

quotes: ai se thumbnail create kar sake prompt deke

acceptanceCriteria: Backend accepts text prompts and returns generated thumbnail images
Images are stored and retrievable
Error handling for failed generation attempts

requirements.text: Create an upload interface where users can upload their own thumbnail images for enhancement

quotes: agar apna thumbnail upload kare to use enhance karde de best bna de

acceptanceCriteria: File upload component accepts image files (PNG, JPG, JPEG)
Preview of uploaded image is shown before enhancement
Upload progress indicator is displayed
Clear error messages for invalid file types or sizes

requirements.text: Implement backend functionality to enhance uploaded thumbnail images to improve their quality and visual appeal

quotes: agar apna thumbnail upload kare to use enhance karde de best bna de

acceptanceCriteria: Backend receives uploaded images and processes them for enhancement
Enhanced version is stored and returned to user
Original upload is preserved for comparison

requirements.text: Create an input interface where users can paste a video link to generate a similar thumbnail

quotes: kisi bhi video ka link upload karne par uske jaisa thumbnail create karde

acceptanceCriteria: Text input field accepts video URLs
Validation for supported video platforms
Button to trigger thumbnail generation from video link
Loading state while processing video link

requirements.text: Implement backend functionality to analyze video links and generate similar thumbnails based on the video content

quotes: kisi bhi video ka link upload karne par uske jaisa thumbnail create karde

acceptanceCriteria: Backend accepts video URLs and extracts or generates thumbnail imagery
Generated thumbnail captures the essence of the video
Thumbnail is stored and returned to frontend

requirements.text: Create an editor interface with customization options where users can modify generated thumbnails according to their preferences

quotes: use apne according change karne ka option bhi ho

acceptanceCriteria: Users can adjust colors, contrast, brightness, or other visual properties
Text overlay options are available if applicable
Preview updates in real-time as changes are made
Save or download the customized thumbnail

requirements.text: Implement backend support for applying user customizations to thumbnails and returning the modified versions

quotes: use apne according change karne ka option bhi ho

acceptanceCriteria: Backend processes customization parameters sent from frontend
Modified thumbnail is generated and stored
Updated thumbnail is returned to user

requirements.text: Design a modern, creative visual theme with bold, vibrant colors and clean typography that emphasizes creativity and visual media, consistently applied across all pages and components
acceptanceCriteria: A cohesive color palette is chosen and used throughout the app
Typography is clear and supports a creative, professional aesthetic
Layout and spacing are optimized for showcasing visual content

constraints: Use only static image generation and manipulation capabilities available to the platform
Do not integrate external AI APIs like OpenAI or third-party video services
nonGoals: Direct integration with YouTube, Vimeo, or other video platform APIs
